# removeSchema

<link-summary>Removes the schema stored on a sheet.</link-summary>

<web-summary>removeSchema() — Removes the schema stored on a sheet. apps-script-utils, English.</web-summary>

<tldr>
<p>Module: <code>appsscript/sheet</code> · Since: 1.11.0</p>
</tldr>

```typescript
function removeSchema(
  sheet: GoogleAppsScript.Spreadsheet.Sheet,
  options: RemoveSchemaOptions | null | undefined = {}
): boolean;
```

The stored description goes; the data and the header row stay exactly as they are. A sheet with no schema stored is left alone and the call reports `false`.

`validation: true` also clears the data validation on the columns the schema described. It is off by default on purpose: Apps Script offers no way to tell a rule the schema created from one a person added by hand, so clearing takes both.

## Parameters

| Parameter                     | Type                                       | Description                                                      |
| :---------------------------- | :----------------------------------------- | :--------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `sheet`                       | `GoogleAppsScript.Spreadsheet.Sheet`       | The sheet to work on.                                            |
| `options` _(optional)_ `= {}` | `RemoveSchemaOptions \| null \| undefined` | `validation` also clears the data validation the schema implied. |

## Returns

`boolean` — `true` when a schema was removed.

## Throws

| Exception               | Condition                          |
| :---------------------- | :--------------------------------- |
| `InvalidSheetException` | the first argument is not a sheet. |

## Examples

### Removing a schema

```javascript
const sheet = SpreadsheetApp.getActiveSheet();

removeSchema(sheet); // => true when one was there
removeSchema(sheet, { validation: true }); // also clears the rules it implied
```
